translationRepairs: In the first month of Qianhua 2, the court proclaimed: "On Lantern Festival night, every market and ward may hang colored lamps; the Gold Crow need not enforce the curfew."
In the first month of Qianhua 2, the court proclaimed: "On Lantern Festival night, every market and ward may hang colored lamps; the Jinwu need not enforce the curfew."
Focus unit 金吾不用禁夜 names the Jinwu capital-guard office that enforced the night curfew; "Gold Crow" is a false character-by-character reading. Jinwu is the correct office title.
In the first month of Qianhua 2, an announcement stated: "On the Lantern Festival night, let every market and ward hang colored lamps; the Gold Crow need not enforce the curfew."
In the first month of Qianhua 2, an announcement stated: "On the Lantern Festival night, let every market and ward hang colored lamps; the Jinwu need not enforce the curfew."
Same focus unit 金吾不用禁夜; literal "Gold Crow" mistranslates the Jinwu office. The proposed Jinwu reading matches the Chinese.

At his death the Emperor mourned at length, sent Luoyuan commissioner Cao Shoucong to condole, and cancelled court for the sixth through eighth; chancellor and officials filed condolence at the Upper Gate.

At his death the Emperor mourned at length, sent Luoyuan commissioner Cao Shoudang to condole, and cancelled court for the sixth through eighth; chancellor and officials filed condolence at the Upper Gate.
Focus unit names 曹守璫; 璫 is dàng, so Cao Shoucong is a misreading. Cao Shoudang is the correct personal name.
